wiki.title: Lindee Brill
wiki.extract: Lindee Rae Brill (née Claerbout; born June 27, 1981) is an American marketing professional and Republican politician from Sheboygan County, Wisconsin. She is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Wisconsin's 27th Assembly district since 2025. She was also previously known as Lindee Rae Salazar, during her first marriage.
